title: Telnet: Fix AUTHENTICATION double-unescaping.
description:
Subversion rev. 28582 added unescaping of telnet option data, however
dissection of Telnet AUTHENTICATION (for which we only support Kerberos 5) was
already performing its own identical unescaping which was left in place, and
that made these messages become double-unescaped.  This can be seen by
dissecting a Kerberos5 authentication request containing four consecutive IACs
(FF FF FF FF), which will be unescaped down to FF FF when telnet option
subnegotiation is dissected, and then down to a single FF as it is being passed
over to the Kerberos dissector.  There is nothing in RFC 2941 or RFC 2942 which
suggests double-unescaping is necessary or desirable.

Since the input to dissect_krb5_authentication_data is already unescaped, let's
remove its own unescaping, then tidy up some remaining references to Kerberos
in the now-generic function unescape_and_tvbuffify_telnet_option, and remove a
now-unused expert info (it was already unreachable).
